summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  **What I did:** read-only trace of the full path (`WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist` → `db/auth.ts`), no files touched.  **What I found:** the code, as it exists in the repo right now, appears to already do this correctly: - No localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist client code (only unrelated theme prefs use localStorage). - Every fetch sends the session cookie (`credentials: "include"`), and the app blocks rendering `WatchlistPage` until `/auth/me` resolves — so there's no race
